items.title: Howie Shear interviewed by Monk Rowe, Dunkirk, New York, October 11, 2014
items.q: How much of that skill required can you attribute to Fredonia and/or Eastman? ... Oh everything.

ctx.x: Yeah, and exciting at the same time because that’s really everything I ever wanted to do is play in the studios see. I saw a big challenge in that.
How much of that skill required can you attribute to Fredonia and/or Eastman?

Oh everything. There’s nothing I saw — let me see if I can phrase this correctly — there is no music I saw in the professional world that was as difficult as I saw in college. It’s all easy after that. Because in college, you know, don’t forget, if you’re selling soap, they don’t want you listening to the music so it can’t be very difficult.
